overall: The AG found the Board's notice topic "Police Chief replacement process" sufficiently specific, so the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: A complainant alleged the April 8, 2013 notice topic 'Police Chief replacement process' was not specific enough to show the Board would vote to appoint a replacement.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the topic was sufficiently specific to reasonably advise members of the public that the Board would be discussing replacing the police chief.

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 5 27 2014 - OML 2014-58 - SOUTHWICK BOARD OF SELECTMEN.pdf
